name: blast-detonation-sequence-ui
description: Visual verification of detonation sequence UI: auto-sequence, delay labels, color coding

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:3 cols:3 spacing:5 depth:6 start:15,15
steps.description: Two increment clicks on the spacing stepper (data-field="spacing") raise it 3->5m (DEFAULT_SPACING_M, Drill.ts) before dragging, so the (15,15)-(25,25) rectangle computes the declared 3x3 instead of the default-spacing 4x4 (issue #479 follow-up, Finding #4).

Real bug found converting this step: role:player + clicking auto-sequence directly looked converted, but with no stepper clicks first the panel's dstepMs stays at its 25ms default -- sequencedCount alone can't catch a wrong delay value, since Auto Sequence assigns every hole a delay regardless of what it is. Sequence's delay-step stepper now carries data-field="delay-step" (Sequence.ts) so a click can target it unambiguously. 5 increment clicks: 25ms default -> 50 (DELAY_STEP_INCREMENT=5ms).

sequence set hole:H1 delay:0 — per-hole delay is only reachable via relative +/- steppers ([data-hole="H1"] [data-action="delay-inc"/"delay-dec"]), not a set-to-value click; reaching an exact target would mean replicating Auto Sequence's row algorithm to compute a click count. Left as a command (Finding #9).
